plan.major: Ethnic Studies for Educators Discipline Emphasis
plan.notes: Official Fullerton College Program Pathways Mapper (fullcoll.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (9) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term. The official map also shows 1 advising milestone(s) (e.g. graduation-application reminders); these are not credit-bearing requirements and are not modeled as courses.

courses.title: Choose a course
courses.choice_note: Choose one course per the official map's “Choose a course” requirement. The mapper's official choice record lists no structured options; see the official map description and catalog. Map description: Required Courses (9 units) Select three courses from ONE of the following discipline tiles listed in this semester. DO NOT TAKE COURSES FROM MORE THAN ONE DISCIPLINE TILE. Discipline tiles include "Comparative Ethnic Studies", "Africana Studies", "American Indian and Indigenous Studies", "Asian Pacific Islander American Studies",  and "Chicanx/Latinx Studies". Please meet with a counselor to ensure you understand the program requirements.
